diff --git a/internal/config/tracing_test.go b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e1c49a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaultsAndLoading(t *testing.T) {
+	defaultTracing := Default().Tracing
+	assert.Equal(t, float64(1), defaultTracing.SamplingRatio)
+	assert.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, defaultTracing.Propagators)
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name        string
+		contents    string
+		wantRatio   float64
+		propagators []TracingPropagator
+	}{
+		{"defaults", "tracing:\n  enabled: true\n", 1, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}},
+		{"configured", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n", 0.5, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}},
+		{"zero", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0\n  propagators: [none]\n", 0, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorNone}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.contents), 0600))
+			result, err := Load(path)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantRatio, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.propagators, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTracingValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN()} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		assert.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+
+	for _, propagator := range []TracingPropagator{
+		TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage, TracingPropagatorB3,
+		TracingPropagatorB3Multi, TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+		TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+	} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{propagator}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"}
+	assert.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestTracingLoadValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name     string
+		contents string
+		wantErr  string
+	}{
+		{"ratio below zero", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: -0.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"ratio above one", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 1.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"invalid propagator", "tracing:\n  propagators: [tracecontext, unknown]\n", "invalid propagator option: unknown"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.contents), 0600))
+			_, err := Load(path)
+			assert.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+		})
+	}
+}
